title: Tally Votes
prompt: A poll receives one candidate name per vote. Write a function that returns an object where each candidate name maps to the number of votes they received.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Tally Votes, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A poll receives one candidate name per vote. Write a function that returns an object where each candidate name maps to the number of votes they received. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure JavaScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is arrays, objects and counting. Pay attention to edge cases and keep the transformation predictable as the input grows.
